models.title: Bayes posterior probability from likelihood and prior
models.summary: Bayes formula updates a prior by multiplying by the event-conditional likelihood and dividing by positive marginal evidence.

relationship.locator: Learning Module3, Bayes Formula, printed p206 (PDF p216), Equation(20); frequency example printed pp207-208/PDF217-218
relationship.translation_notes: Source symbols map directly to separately defined prior, likelihood, marginal evidence and posterior quantities. All are dimensionless; likelihood is a conditional probability here, not a density. Coherence bounds require likelihood*prior<=evidence<=likelihood*prior+1-prior.

models.title: Multiplication rule for finite sequential task counts
models.summary: When each successive stage has a fixed number of choices for any preceding path, complete sequence counts multiply.

relationship.locator: Learning Module3, Principles of Counting, printed pp212-213 (PDF pp222-223), unnumbered multiplication rule, Exhibit21 and factorial definition; permutation printed p215/PDF225 Eq23
relationship.translation_notes: All counts are dimensionless cardinalities. n! is the specialization branches=[n,n-1,...,1]; ordered r-permutations use[n,n-1,...,n-r+1].
